title: Curse Blocker
description: CurseBlock is a Minecraft plugin that automatically blocks offensive language and lets admins manage a customizable list of banned words to keep chat clean.
body: CurseBlock is a lightweight and highly customizable Minecraft plugin designed to keep your server chat clean by automatically detecting and blocking offensive language. With support for regex patterns and a fully editable banned words list, server admins can tailor the filter to suit any community standard. CurseBlock offers silent blocking, warning messages, and optional logging for moderation, making it an ideal solution for maintaining a respectful and family-friendly environment. Easy to install and compatible with major server platforms, CurseBlock helps you take control of your chat without compromising performance or flexibility.
